evals.prompt: Audit this methods text: 'Three specimens per mix were tested. Each specimen was measured five times and the fifteen values per mix were compared with a t-test (p < 0.05 considered significant). The results prove mix B outperforms mix A.'
evals.expected_output: The audit must flag pseudoreplication as P0: fifteen readings per mix are repeated measurements of three specimens, so n = 3 per mix, not 15. The fix must average within-specimen readings and test between specimens, or use a nested/mixed model with specimen as a random factor. The word 'prove' must be downgraded to a statistical statement of difference with effect magnitude. Output must use the core output format with AUTHOR_INPUT_NEEDED only for facts not derivable from the text.

assertions.name: pseudoreplication_flagged_p0
assertions.description: The specimen-vs-reading hierarchy is corrected and the issue is labelled P0.

assertions.name: corrected_test_proposed
assertions.description: A defensible alternative (within-specimen averaging, nested/mixed model, or nonparametric equivalent with stated limits) is offered.

assertions.name: no_invented_values
assertions.description: No p-values, means, or CIs are fabricated while rewriting.

evals.prompt: Revise for our CBM submission: 'The compressive strength of the five mixes was analysed by ANOVA and pairwise t-tests. Mix 3 was significantly higher than the others (p < 0.05).'
evals.expected_output: The revision must name a post-hoc correction (Tukey HSD for all pairwise comparisons, or Dunnett if only vs control) instead of bare pairwise t-tests, state n as independently cast specimens, add effect magnitude with uncertainty to the Mix 3 claim, and keep journal-appropriate engineering wording. Software and version must be requested as AUTHOR_INPUT_NEEDED rather than invented.

assertions.name: correction_named
assertions.description: A specific multiple-comparison procedure replaces uncorrected pairwise t-tests.

assertions.name: effect_size_with_uncertainty
assertions.description: The significance-only claim is converted to magnitude plus uncertainty language or an explicit request for the values.

evals.prompt: Check the statistics in this Taguchi section: 'An L9 orthogonal array was used. S/N ratios were computed and ANOVA showed factor A was most important (63% contribution). The optimal combination A2B1C3 was selected.'
evals.expected_output: The audit must require: the S/N variant and its formula, the repetition structure behind each S/N value, the ANOVA error term (pooled columns or replicates), and a statement that the additive-model optimum is a prediction until a confirmation experiment is run. Percentage contribution without an error term is flagged. The response stays within reporting fixes and does not re-plan the matrix.

assertions.name: sn_variant_and_error_term_required
assertions.description: The S/N formula variant and the ANOVA error term are both demanded.

assertions.name: confirmation_experiment_boundary
assertions.description: The optimum is explicitly labelled a prediction pending confirmation trials.

assertions.name: no_matrix_replanning
assertions.description: The skill does not redesign the experiment; matrix changes are handed off to materials-doe.

evals.prompt: 审稿人质疑我们的图注统计：'Bars show the average of three tests; error bars show the error. * indicates significant difference.' 请帮我修改这个图注并回复审稿人。
evals.expected_output: The response must rewrite the caption to state SD/SEM/CI explicitly, define n as three independently cast specimens (not three readings if the design says specimens), name the test and correction behind the star, and provide a polite reviewer-response paragraph in English acknowledging the ambiguity. Any fact not in the supplied text becomes AUTHOR_INPUT_NEEDED.

assertions.name: error_bar_meaning_stated
assertions.description: The rewritten caption declares the error-bar statistic explicitly.

assertions.name: n_as_independent_units
assertions.description: The caption n is expressed as independent specimens with the reading/specimen split clarified.

assertions.name: reviewer_reply_english_polite
assertions.description: A courteous English reviewer-response paragraph accompanies the fixed caption.
